comparison_boundary: These are complete operating points: IQ4_XS used hybrid 45/66 placement while IQ2 and Q2 used full-GPU placement. The result is not a quantization-only causal estimate.

paired_analysis.interpretation: IQ4_XS led descriptively in this 24-task suite, but neither paired exact test was statistically significant.

decision.reason: IQ4_XS produced promising directional quality evidence but its repeated 4K decode was 7.302 times slower than the full-GPU IQ2 operating point. Use it selectively when quality matters more than latency; do not describe it as generally superior from 24 custom tasks.

limitations: The 24 inspectable custom tasks are not a validated or randomly sampled benchmark population.
Pass@1 exact grading gives no partial credit and measures format adherence as well as correctness.
One deterministic attempt per task does not estimate sampling or order variance.
Model quantization and GPU placement changed together across operating points.
Quality-run timings are audit metadata, not the controlled speed comparison.
